name: Industrial
description: Mechanized rock arc — sampled machine-noise intro, grinding chug verse, gang-shout chorus, a harsh noise breakdown, and a staged mechanical shutdown.

defaults.concept: Industrial rock/metal — detuned, monolithic guitar chugs locked in unison with a sequenced sub-bass, rigid quantized drum-machine precision, heavily processed/shouted vocals, and sampled factory noise. Cold, dystopian, mechanically relentless.

slots.label: Machine Room Intro
slots.purpose: FEEL: Cold, ominous, pre-industrial hum. TRICK: Open on foley/sample hits alone — steam hiss, metal clangs, a distant conveyor loop — before any melodic element enters, so the machine introduces the song rather than a musician.
slots.groove: Irregular sampled machine hits and clangs over a slow sub-bass pulse; no kit yet, tension building through volume alone.

slots.label: The Grinding Pocket
slots.purpose: FEEL: Grinding, oppressive, relentless. PRODUCTION NOTE: Layer the sequenced sub-bass in unison with the guitar's low string so the riff reads as one machine, not a band.
slots.groove: Rigid quantized four-on-the-floor kick under palm-muted 16th-note guitar chugs; programmed snare cracks hard on 2 and 4, zero swing.

slots.label: Gang-Shout Catharsis
slots.purpose: FEEL: Anthemic but still mechanical — catharsis, not release. TRICK: Double the lead vocal with a heavily bit-crushed parallel take to simulate a PA-announcement or radio-transmission quality underneath the clean vocal.
slots.groove: Double-time snare hits, gang-shouted vocal stabs on the downbeats, sequenced bass doubling the guitar riff in tight unison.

slots.label: The Noise Wall
slots.purpose: FEEL: Disorienting, a wall of industrial noise. TRICK: Replace the kit entirely with processed machine samples (hydraulic presses, grinding metal) panned hard and swelling in volume to build dread before the final section.
slots.groove: Noise/machine-clang wash replaces the drum kit; a single distorted pulse throbs underneath, no defined backbeat.

slots.label: Powering Down
slots.purpose: FEEL: Terminal, a machine shutting off. TRICK: Cut instruments out one at a time from the top of the frequency spectrum down, like a factory floor powering off floor by floor, ending on sub-bass alone before a hard cut.
slots.groove: Mechanical shutdown — kit elements drop out in stages; ends on a dead stop, no fade.
